scope: The 1,000 largest United States companies in the current 2026 Fortune ranking, used as a breadth-first AMACS taxonomy validation corpus.
boundaries: The external roster is retrieved for analysis and is not vendored in the AMACS repository.
Only organization identity, position, headquarters, and primary activity label are carried into generated research observations; financial measures are excluded.
An industry proxy identifies candidate AMACS concepts and taxonomy gaps; it is not evidence that an organization possesses a capability.
Generated records are marked not_for_profile_import and require first-party evidence plus entity-resolution review before any separate organization capability assertion could be considered.
